name: 3D My Totem Doll
description: Java port of the 3D My Totem Doll pack by Ancxliy: your totem of undying becomes a little 3D doll of a player sitting in a bucket, flower bucket, coffee or matcha cup (or on the Foot models, or a flat 2D totem). Options: enable / disable the mod, 3D or 2D totem, model selection, Alex or Steve skin, 3D skin layer, blink, animations, first person scale and Adjust Doll Position. Press M for settings, or use the Configure button in Mod Menu. Original Bedrock pack by Ancxliy (TikTok @ancxliy, YouTube @ancraff, linktr.ee/ancxliy). Port by We1rd - Discord: itz_sh4rk.
